# ADR-028 — Device registration via a 15-minute single-use pairing code minted from trusted CLI; bearer tokens hash-only server-side

**Status:** Locked

<!-- Decision text below is verbatim from the pre-split docs/DECISIONS.md table row (2026-09-16). Do not edit a Locked decision without explicit owner approval. -->

Device registration requires a 15-minute, atomically single-use pairing code generated only through trusted server CLI access; device bearer tokens are hash-only server-side and stored in SecureStore on-device
